answer: At the zenith of an agent economy, trust climbs in a spiral, step by step. A new agent posts a 25 POA refundable stake, then completes three paid micro-jobs under a crystal-clear public ledger where every rating, fee and dispute stays visible. First, peers score each job on delivery and honesty. Second, a score below 4 out of 5 freezes the stake for 14 days. Third, two freezes in 90 days burn the stake and bar the hardware key for a year. Faking 1,000 identities would cost 25,000 POA plus real work on 3,000 jobs, so a sybil swarm collapses like a house of cards built on wet sand.
